NEW local information on 16 Sep is housing transmission. Dollar-king's AU-rates-higher residual is the same hole in FX clothes: AONIA toward 4.86 is used to keep AUD from being the USD short, which is an AUD-supportive rates assumption. Cross-merchant and positioning-cynic agree AUD lower but express it in AUDCAD or CA-AU 2Y. Those need CAD catch-up and fight 206bp of cash carry, or sit in a 1y-median RV. Rates is the cleaner expression of the AU overshoot; AUDUSD is not the stretch; NZ yields are unavailable so AUDNZD is not rates-anchored.

Perma-bear/rate-dove same-instrument longs do not rescue rate-hawk. They concede the housing/AONIA tension and then overfit it into easing-cycle or risk-off claims. This remit fades the 2Y overshoot toward the live path, not a statistical mean and not a mandated cut strip. Analog 2025-12-22 (2Y then +8.8bp 1m / +54.7bp 3m) remains the continuation risk; 2022-09-28 is the mechanism analog, not a pooled forecast.
